# Thimathi Dissanayake

> Software Engineer, Data Engineer, Product Designer, and AI Researcher specializing in scalable distributed software, enterprise data pipelines, and multimodal affective computing.

Thimathi Dissanayake is a technology professional based in Sri Lanka holding a Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Computer Science with First-Class Honours (72% aggregate) from the University of Wolverhampton (delivered via CINEC Campus). He serves as a Data Engineer at CreativeX Technology (Pvt) Ltd and Product Designer at NONO AI, with academic research accepted for presentation at the 7th CINEC International Research Symposium (CIRS 2026).

## Projects & Case Studies

- [Baby Mine Case Study](https://www.thimathi.online/projects/baby-mine): All-in-one maternal and pediatric support mobile application built with React Native and Supabase PostgreSQL.
- [Aurevia Research Study](https://www.thimathi.online/projects/aurevia): Deep-dive into the dual-stream affective computing architecture combining fine-tuned BERT NLP and acoustic SER CNNs with late-fusion decision logic.

## AI Research & Publications

- [Aurevia CIRS 2026 Preprint on ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/408064387_Aurevia_A_Multimodal_Artificial_Intelligence_Framework_for_Burnout_Detection_and_Emotional_Well-Being_Monitoring_Using_Textual_and_Speech-Based_Emotional_Analysis): Academic paper on multimodal affective computing for emotional well-being monitoring.
